title: KHQR deposit pressure
description: A seller asks for a deposit through KHQR before a meeting or delivery.
match_terms: send deposit|pay deposit|reserve it for you|KHQR now
recommendation: Do not pay a deposit before independently verifying the seller and item.

title: Parcel or customs fee request
description: A supposed courier asks for an unexpected parcel release or customs payment.
match_terms: customs fee|parcel is held|package cannot be delivered|delivery release fee
recommendation: Use the courier's official website or phone number to verify a delivery.

title: Bank account update lure
description: A message asks the recipient to update or unlock a bank account through an unsolicited contact.
match_terms: update your bank account|unlock your bank account|bank security update|verify your ABA account
recommendation: Open the official banking app yourself instead of using a message link.

title: Guaranteed crypto return
description: A crypto offer promises guaranteed or risk-free returns.
match_terms: guaranteed crypto profit|risk free crypto|double your USDT|daily crypto return
recommendation: Do not transfer crypto based on promised returns or private messages.

title: Task commission recharge
description: A task offer requires a recharge or deposit to unlock commission.
match_terms: recharge to unlock|task commission|complete tasks for commission|deposit to continue task
recommendation: Do not pay to unlock work tasks or earnings.

title: Romance emergency transfer
description: A relationship contact uses an emergency story to request money.
match_terms: emergency hospital bill|send money through Wing|cannot access my bank account|repay you tomorrow
recommendation: Verify the person's identity using an independent real-time contact method.

title: Government fine payment
description: A message claims an official fine must be paid immediately through an unofficial channel.
match_terms: unpaid traffic penalty|official fine notice|pay legal penalty|avoid legal action
recommendation: Check fines through the official government service rather than a message payment link.

title: Loan processing fee
description: A loan offer asks for a processing or release fee before funds are provided.
match_terms: loan processing fee|fee to release loan|approved loan fee|pay before loan release
recommendation: Legitimate lenders do not require unexplained advance fees through private messages.

title: Remote support app request
description: A sender asks the recipient to install a remote-support application.
match_terms: install AnyDesk|download TeamViewer|remote support app|share your screen with support
recommendation: Never install remote-control software for an unsolicited caller or message.

title: Social account recovery lure
description: A message claims that a social account requires urgent recovery or verification.
match_terms: recover your Facebook account|Instagram account recovery|social account will be disabled|verify your social account
recommendation: Use the social platform's official app or website directly to check account status.
